title: Fix lichen-node --all-features build errors
description: 53 compilation errors when building lichen-node with --all-features flag. Pre-existing structural issues from feature-gated module reorganization drift. Errors include: unresolved imports (RplMaintenanceOutcome, HOP_SCHEDULE_LEN, etc.), missing methods (local_public_key), non-exhaustive pattern matches, borrow conflicts, and missing macros (vec!).
close_reason: Fixed all 53 compilation errors. Workflow applied 57 fixes across 20 files including: missing imports, vec! macro scope, API drift (local_public_key, options_tail), type mismatches, visibility fixes, and enum variant updates.
